key_idea: The proof slowly rotates Berger-type link metrics along the radial direction, steering the angular modes with Lie-algebraic control (bracket generation of sl(V_l)). This makes the growth rates of harmonic functions average below the Euclidean degree, so more harmonic functions of polynomial growth exist than in flat space.
reason: The core idea is genuinely creative: a cone-like metric whose link drifts through Berger spheres, combined with a control-theoretic word in complex structures that tunes the exact transmission of each period. But the argument rests on long chains of uniform estimates, pulse asymptotics, quantile inequalities for Beta distributions and multi-scale bookkeeping, so the reason for the inequality is hidden under heavy technical machinery.
